scripts.build:pwa: npm run build && echo 'PWA build - requires workbox-cli: npm install -g workbox-cli && workbox generateSW'
scripts.build:electron: npm run build && echo 'Electron build - requires electron-builder: npm install --save-dev electron electron-builder'
scripts.build:tauri: npm run build && echo 'Tauri build - requires: npm install --save-dev @tauri-apps/cli && cargo install tauri-cli'
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build && echo 'Mobile build - requires: npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/ios @capacitor/android'
scripts.build:all: npm run build && echo 'Standard build complete. See DEPLOYMENT.md for standalone app builds.'
